Collins Aerospace, part of RTX, develops aerospace and defense systems and offers opportunities to work on complex avionics challenges. The Software Engineer I will support Mission Sensors, Weapons, and IFF avionics systems through requirements development, software development, testing, verification, integration, and Agile collaboration.
Aerospace

Military
Satellite Communication

U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Help ensure mission-critical avionics software performs flawlessly in the real world
You will help design and define software requirements using DOORs
You will develop automated and semi-automated test scripts using Python to validate software functionality and system performance
You will verify software builds in integrated lab environments and support formal verification events for major program deliveries
You will collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to refine system requirements and design solutions that meet customer needs
You will present technical progress and status updates to Agile team members and engineering leadership
You will contribute to improving test development processes, tools, and best practices while maintaining compliance with company standards
You will gain experience integrating Line Replaceable Unit (LRU) software supporting mission sensors, weapons, and IFF avionics systems
You will deepen your expertise across multiple phases of the aerospace systems lifecycle within a collaborative Agile environment
You will strengthen your software engineering skills by supporting software development, verification and integration efforts
